answer.summary: The API Types Check failed because the committed src/utils/api-types.d.ts is stale. Regenerating from the API adds node_relation_counts to GraphNodeOutput, which this PR's GraphExplorationApi.java change appears to introduce. The generator is deterministic, so a re-run will produce the same diff. Fix: run yarn generate-types-from-api and commit the updated api-types.d.ts.

evidence.quote: ⚠️ Forgot to generate types! Please run 'yarn run generate-types-from-api' before committing.
